candidate.title: Sequencing by Synthesis
candidate.scope: The assigned Illumina poster-footer implementation of flowcell attachment, bridge amplification, and dual-indexed paired-end sequencing by synthesis. One continuous surface-template route is depicted, including Index1, P5 deblocking/unlabeled extension, Index2, and complementary-template regeneration. Bridge amplification is a component, not an additional target method. This is a sequencing mechanism and readout explanation starting from an adapter-bearing DNA library, not a sample-preparation assay. The input library represents whatever biological sequences its unspecified upstream preparation placed in its inserts; this panel cannot identify a specific biological analyte, specimen, selection, or RNA-to-DNA conversion. The supported readout is insert-end and index sequence associated through a surface cluster. No instrument generation, kit version, historical priority, or applicability to all Illumina implementations is established. The flowcell overview and many amplification arches illustrate surface localization and copy multiplication, not extra target workflows.

operations.label: Adapter hybridizes to flowcell
operations.description: An adapter-bearing incoming strand anneals to one surface oligo, converting a free library strand to a surface-hybridized template.
operations.information_effect: Establishes the physical surface association that supports subsequent copying and sequencing.

evidence.locator: Left: Adapter hybridizes to flowcell; free strand over two surface oligos

operations.label: Reverse strand synthesis
operations.description: The annealed surface oligo is extended along the library strand to make its reverse complement; the original forward strand and new surface-attached reverse strand form a duplex.
operations.mechanism: Template-directed complementary strand synthesis from the flowcell primer.
operations.information_effect: The library sequence is transferred to a surface-attached complementary copy; this is not RNA-to-cDNA conversion.

evidence.locator: Left: Reverse strand synthesis; extended surface oligo and labeled Forward strand / Reverse strand duplex

operations.label: Remove forward strand
operations.description: The original forward strand leaves the duplex, leaving the newly synthesized reverse copy attached to the flowcell.
operations.information_effect: Retains a surface copy of the incoming library sequence while discarding its original strand.

evidence.locator: Left: Remove forward strand; departing pale strand and retained tethered strand

operations.label: Fold over and hybridize to second primer
operations.description: The tethered single strand bends over and its other end anneals to the second surface primer, forming a single-stranded bridge.
operations.mechanism: Fold-over bridge formation and hybridization to a second flowcell oligo.
operations.information_effect: Changes attachment geometry without changing the represented insert.
